title: etrade_premarket record
description: One symbol's live pre-market summary up to a cutoff (sourcing-py etrade premarket): typical-price VWAP and volume of the bars in [04:00 ET, cutoff) on `date`.

cutoff.description: HH:MM ET; bars with DT strictly before it.

vol_10d_mean_source.description: Mean daily volume of the 10 sessions before `date`, in the same source.

last_bar_dt.description: UTC time of the newest bar used.
